issues/{n}.body:
## Parent

#331 — Record GitHub API contracts and drive the gh stub from them

## What to build

Make the stubbed `gh` adapter answer the factory's GitHub issue API calls from captured responses, so issue-adapter behavior is checked against recorded response shapes and unknown endpoints fail tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Recorded responses under `factory/tests/contracts/` cover the GitHub issue endpoints consumed by the factory adapter: issue lookup and listing, comments, events, parent, sub-issues, and dependencies.
- [ ] The `FakeGh` stub serves those recorded responses and fails tests for an issue endpoint without a recording.
- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_deploy.py` and `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_gate_github.py` pass using recorded issue fakes.
- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_contracts.py` passes `test_recordings_contain_no_tokens` for GitHub recordings.

Affected repositories: slop-factory. Size: about 380 lines with tests and recordings.

## What to build

Make the stubbed `gh` adapter answer only from captured GitHub API responses, so adapter behavior is checked against recorded response shapes and unrecorded endpoints fail tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Recorded responses under `factory/tests/contracts/` cover each `gh api` response consumed by the factory adapter.
- [ ] The stubbed `gh` returns the recorded response for each covered endpoint and fails a test when asked for an endpoint without a recording.
- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_deploy.py` and `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_gate_github.py` pass using recorded fakes.
- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_contracts.py` passes `test_recordings_contain_no_tokens` for GitHub recordings.
- [ ] The `state-machine` check in `factory.descriptor.yaml` passes.

Affected repositories: slop-factory. Size: about 150 changed lines including tests and GitHub recordings.

issues/{n}/dependencies/blocked_by.title: Test fakes come from recordings of the real Air and GitHub services

repository.name: slop-factory
repository.description: Slop factory: an agent software factory on Air Cloud

issues/{n}/dependencies/blocked_by.body:
[factory] Test fakes are generated from recordings of the real services. Guessed fakes let real mismatches pass the tests: the Air payload wrapper (#228), the MCP tool names (#288), and `list_automations`'s result shape.

## Scope

- **`factory/tests/contracts/`** holds recorded, secret-free samples:
  - the air-automations and air-cloud tool lists with their input schemas (from `~/.pi/agent/mcp-cache.json`);
  - one real response per tool the factory calls;
  - one real Air trigger payload per event type (`issues.labeled`, `pull_request.labeled`, `pull_request.merged`, `pull_request_review.submitted`, `issues.closed`);
  - the `gh api` responses the adapter reads.
- **The fake MCP server and the stubbed `gh`** answer only from these recordings, and a call to a tool or endpoint that isn't recorded fails the test.
- **`factory contracts refresh`** re-records them from the live services (operator only), stripping tokens, emails and ids that look like secrets.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_contracts.py` passes:
  - `test_fake_mcp_rejects_unrecorded_tool`;
  - `test_payload_fixtures_parse_for_every_trigger`;
  - `test_recordings_contain_no_tokens`
- [ ] `uv run --quiet factory/tests/test_deploy.py` and `test_gate_github.py` pass on the recorded fakes
- [ ] The `state-machine` check from `factory.descriptor.yaml` passes

Affected repositories: slop-factory. Size: about 250 lines with tests, plus recordings.

Factory-Run: manual:pi-session-2026-10-31


Operator answer (2 November): recorded fixtures count toward the size. Split this ticket at triage into independently deliverable slices (for example: the recorder and Air fakes first, then the GitHub fakes), each under about 400 lines.
